label: Boot Tread Cast
description: Plaster forensic cast of a boot impression taken from the muddy ground at the farmhouse rear entrance — tread pattern consistent with size 10.5 Canadian Forces parade boots recovered from the suspect's Tweed residence.

label: Crime Scene: Farmhouse
description: Isolated 1920s limestone farmhouse along the Highway 37 corridor, Hastings County — victim's residence and primary scene. Remote location with cleared fields and no neighbours within 800 metres; multiple unforced external entry points documented.

label: Recovered Trophy Box
description: Dark mahogany wooden box with a brass hasp lock, recovered under the floorboards of the suspect's Tweed property during search warrant execution — contents include personal articles traced to multiple victims.

label: Colonel's Beret
description: Canadian Forces dark-blue officer's beret bearing Colonel rank insignia and CFB Trenton unit badge — found in the suspect's personal effects. Williams's command role had initially created the impression of an alibi too visible to permit the offences.
